fact: The health ministry's digital directorate reports that at the 25 March 2025 steering committee of the PAPE Digitalisation project, chaired by the minister's deputy chief of staff with the ministry's central directorates, the project management unit said the first phase had connected 268 health establishments to the hospital information system (SIH) and the Dossier Patient Informatisé, that 97 billion FCFA is needed by 2030, and that scale-up and access to rural areas remain challenges; it does not say how many of the 268 are first-contact establishments.
title: Digitalisation du système de santé en Côte d'Ivoire : le comité de pilotage du projet Pape Digitalisation fait le point
publisher: Direction de l'Informatique et de la Santé Digitale (DISD)
